turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
the best burn from your 3" pillar, trim the wick to 1/4" before every lighting and let it burn for at least 3 hours each time so the wax pool reaches the edges without tunneling.
After a couple of burns, gently mold the warm top edges inward toward the flame to consume all the wax evenly—just be careful not to press too far down or you'll drown the wick. When you're ready to put it out, dip the wick into the liquid wax to extinguish it without smoke.
